top_stories.title: At Jantar Mantar, Abhijeet Dipke says ‘can’t erase us’ — then ultimatum to Dharmendra Pradhan to resign | Delhi News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Abhijeet Dipke**, founder of the online youth movement **Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)**, arrived at Jantar Mantar after a delay caused by police interference.  Dipke delivered an ultimatum to **Dharmendra Pradhan**, Education Minister, demanding his resignation by 5 pm or face continued protests across India. The crowd chanted slogans calling for Pradhan's resignation and the unity of youth. Dipke was lifted onto protestors' shoulders in a celebratory gesture, highlighting the movement's growing momentum.

top_stories.title: ‘It’s Not a Joke’: A ‘Simpsons’ Writer Holds His First Presidential Campaign Rally | WIRED
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Dan Greaney**, a veteran TV writer and former president of the Harvard Lampoon, launched his campaign for US President on Friday in Los Angeles.  He presented an earnest platform focused on progressive Republican values including expanding the Supreme Court, reforming the judicial branch, and advocating for universal healthcare and a Green New Deal.  Greaney, known for his work on "The Simpsons," also pledged to address corporate influence in politics. He was introduced by artist and writer Mieke Marple, his campaign director, who encouraged attendees to support his movement.

top_stories.title: CJP at Jantar Mantar: How Jantar Mantar became Delhi's protest hub
top_stories.rephrased_article: Hundreds gathered at Delhi's Jantar Mantar on Saturday to protest irregularities in examinations and demand the resignation of **Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan**. The protest, organized by online youth movement Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), founder Abhijeet Dipke,  was a symbolic move as it took place at the site where social activist Anna Hazare began his hunger strike against corruption in 2011. The CJP's first on-ground action follows its rapid rise to prominence online after being inspired by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant's courtroom comment comparing some youth to cockroaches.  The protest is part of a long history of demonstrations at Jantar Mantar, which has hosted protests against corruption, farm distress, and other social issues.

top_stories.title: The Moons of Uranus May Hold the Key to Finding Missing Planets | WIRED
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Icarus** researchers analyzed 122 scenarios of planetary instability to assess how the moons of Uranus might have evolved. The study concluded that the current characteristics of Uranus' moons are best explained by episodes of violent instability, likely occurring at least twice: once due to an impact and again during encounters with giant planets. This instability is most likely linked to the existence of one or more missing planets that were ejected from the solar system.  The research suggests that these missing bodies could have influenced the current structure of the solar system, leaving behind clues in the form of unusual moons like Miranda, which may be remnants of a larger body.

top_stories.title: Importance of being Satish Poonia: Why BJP’s key Rajasthan Jat face is its Rajya Sabha pick | Political Pulse News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **BJP** has nominated **Satish Poonia**, a prominent Jat leader, to the Rajya Sabha from Rajasthan as a way to appease the community while keeping him away from direct involvement in state politics. This move comes after the BJP's 2024 Lok Sabha election loss in Rajasthan where the **INDIA alliance** swept the Jat belt and the party faced criticism for its handling of Jat concerns, including the denial of tickets to prominent Jat leaders and a perceived lack of representation. Poonia has been instrumental in navigating internal power struggles within the party, particularly against former Chief Minister Vasundhara Raje, but his influence may be limited by the BJP's desire to avoid alienating traditional vote banks.

top_stories.title: Another Setback For AIADMK, Former Ministers, MLAs Join Vijay's TVK, tamil nadu politics
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Four former AIADMK ministers and ex-MLAs** joined the ruling **TVK** party in Chennai on Saturday, following a series of setbacks for the AIADMK after the April 23 election. The defectors, including Udumalai K Radhakrishnan, MC Sampath, Kadambur C Raju, and NR Sivapathi, joined in front of **TVK General Secretary Anand** and **General Secretary for election campaign management Aadhav Arjuna**. This latest move follows a trend of AIADMK members joining **TVK**, including former ministers Vellamandi Natarajan and Anandan, as well as former MLAs.

top_stories.title: 'No community should live in fear': British MP backs Southampton Sikhs amid rising hostility after Vickrum Digwa's conviction | World News - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Independent MP Adnan Hussain** expressed solidarity with Southampton's Sikh community after reports of increased fear and intimidation following the murder of 18-year-old student Henry Nowak. **Hussain** stated that no group should be blamed for the actions of an individual, urging the government to prioritize the safety of the Sikh community and provide necessary reassurance.  **Gurdwara Khalsa Darbar**, a representative body for the Southampton Sikh community, reported increased racial abuse and hostility towards residents following Digwa's conviction, leading to cancelled events and fears among members.

top_stories.title: Woman, Lover Accused Of Killing Her 5-Year-Old Daughter In Bengaluru
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Priyanka**, a woman from Bengaluru, and her alleged lover **Mohan** have been accused of murdering her five-year-old daughter, Vennila. The child died on March 24th, but the case was reported by the father, Praveen, nearly three months later.  Police arrested **Mohan** while **Priyanka** is currently at large.  The investigation is ongoing and awaits a report from the Forensic Science Laboratory (FSL).

top_stories.title: Crypto-Funded Chinese Peptide Labs Are Booming | WIRED
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Meta** has been quietly storing dormant face recognition code on its smart glasses, a feature known as NameTag. **xAI**, a company developing AI technology, is asking a federal judge to force four people suing the company over deepfakes to drop their pseudonyms and litigate under their real names. Meanwhile, Google has rolled out a new Android feature aimed at combating AI-powered impersonation scams.  The Manhattan Institute, a right-wing think tank, is pushing legislation that would turn minor protest offenses into felonies. Researchers have discovered a new browser side-channel attack called FROST that fingerprints other tabs and apps on your device. **Anthropic**, an AI firm, is helping the NSA with offensive hacking using its powerful Mythos tool.  **Bill Pulte** has been tapped as acting director of national intelligence while **Donald Trump** considers other candidates for the permanent position.

top_stories.title: ‘Not about Sikhism’: 11 Sikh MPs issue statement amid outrage over Henry Nowak's murder by Vickrum Digwa - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Eleven Sikh MPs**, including **Jas Athwal**, **Preet Kaur Gill**, and **Tan Dhesi**, issued a joint statement distancing the Sikh faith from the murder of 18-year-old Henry Nowak. The MPs emphasized that the case was not about Sikhism, as the weapon used was an offensive blade, not a kirpan, and no religious exemption applied.  The MPs condemned the killing as a "horrific and senseless crime" and stressed that knife crime continues to devastate families and communities across Britain. They also called for an end to stigmatizing the entire faith community.
